P1.title: 30-minute lock-screen playback is unsupported by the fixed sentence queue
reproduction: Start play_full with a real AudioTrack.
Temporarily set stay_on_while_plugged_in=0 and power the screen off.
Observe AudioTrack starts/completions and service state for 30 minutes.
P1.observed: 9/9 sentences completed at screen-off+93.819 s; queue completed at 93.858 s; no AudioTrack start during the remaining approximately 1707 s. PID/FGS/notification remained alive but MediaSession was STOPPED.
P1.impact: Users cannot receive 30 minutes of continuous reading from the background TTS path.
P1.minimalNextImplementation: Provide a continuous source longer than 30 minutes or an approved continuation policy that turns more content into new TTS sentences without requiring page/ViewModel ownership, while maintaining one AudioTrack owner, one MediaSession, truthful pause/stop and no silent auto-restart after explicit pause/stop.

P2.title: MIUI SystemUI media card does not expose the notification stop action
reproduction: Start TTS and expand the notification shade.
Inspect the SystemUI media-card action nodes.
P2.observed: The app NotificationRecord contains four actions including 停止, but the system card exposes only previous, play/pause and next; the fourth slot is disabled. Actual stop taps worked from UI and MediaSession, not from SystemUI.
P2.impact: The requested system-notification stop path is unavailable on the target K60/MIUI surface.
P2.minimalNextImplementation: Use a system-integrated media control surface that exposes stop as a real action, or explicitly define the supported system-control capability and keep UI/MediaSession stop as the guaranteed fallback.

P3.title: Independent debug build is not byte-reproducible
P3.detail: Same source and size produced a different SHA-256 due to D8 synthetic lambda naming and metadata. This does not change the fixed APK runtime evidence but weakens byte-for-byte rebuild claims.

P3.title: Long-screen test must neutralize stay-on-while-plugged-in
P3.detail: The first 30-minute attempt woke at about 17 minutes because K60 had stay_on_while_plugged_in=15. The invalid attempt is retained as background-30m-aborted-*; the valid rerun temporarily set 0 and restored 15.

newReusableExperienceCandidates.fact: Android K60 can wake during a long screen-off run when stay_on_while_plugged_in is 15; long-screen QA must capture, set it to 0, verify Asleep throughout, and restore the exact original value.
MIUI SystemUI may omit a Notification ACTION_STOP even when dumpsys shows the NotificationRecord has four actions; system-control claims need an actual UI node/tap, not NotificationRecord text alone.
D8 debug APK rebuilds can differ byte-for-byte because synthetic lambda names and metadata change; compare fixed SHA and runtime behavior separately from source rebuild success.
A never-networked UID can have no netstats identity rows; zero delta is still empty-set evidence and must be reported as a limitation unless a calibrated traffic probe exists.
